catalogVersion: 1.1 (with the text corrections of re-review 2, applied before the freeze)
written: v1.0 drafted 2026-10-28 between 16:35Z and 16:58Z; v1.1 revised between 17:00Z and 17:10Z (methodology review 1); re-review 2 corrections between 17:25Z and 17:32Z; all before any momentum mechanism was run on market data (clock times of the surrounding steps)

conventions.session: a regular NYSE session of data/VGT/data.csv (America/New_York date); O = the first regular minute's open, C = the closing print (else the last regular minute's close), H/L include the close
conventions.observability: a daily feature at session s uses sessions <= s only and is known at the close of s; minute rules use completed minutes only (decision time = bar start + 60 s)
conventions.dailyExecution: a decision at the close of s executes at the first regular-session trade of s+1 (its opening trade)
conventions.minuteExecution: a decision at a completed minute executes at the first trade at or after the decision time (the next minute's open, or the closing print for a decision before the close; otherwise the next session's opening trade) — the frozen D1 rule (src/shared-margin-portfolio/strategy.ts firstTradeAfterDecision)
conventions.sigma_N: sample standard deviation of r over sessions s-N+1..s, annualised by sqrt(252)
conventions.firstDecisionClose: 2017-01-03 (first close allowed to decide an entry; first order fills 2017-01-04)
conventions.quantization: percentage parameters to 0.1 percentage point; ratio parameters (ER, CUSUM, CLV) to 0.01 (CUSUM thresholds 0.1); session counts integers
conventions.campaignState: after an exit other than own OUT the campaign is alive while the family's own condition holds: level: state IN at each close; event and intraday: own OUT not yet true at a close; E11: permission ON. An own-OUT condition seen at a close while long ends the campaign at the exit even when the configuration does not exit on own OUT. While alive, the re-entry rule applies; an event family's fresh trigger re-enters the same campaign with the new signal's references (R-rule re-entries keep the campaign's); under R5 nothing enters while alive; R2's cool-down yields to a fresh trigger; R1 admits fresh signals only. First entry = an entry while no campaign is alive. A level family's own OUT is the state being OUT at a close.
conventions.sessionRule: at most one entry fills per session and none in a session that had an exit (a close-decided entry at the close of an exit session fills next open); if one close yields an exit and an entry signal, only the exit executes; Z1/Z2 tranche changes are not entries
conventions.stateStart: state machines (hysteresis, E04 CUSUM, E05 zigzag, E11 permission, E07 pending breakout) start at the first session where their inputs are defined, counting from 2016-01-04; level states start OUT; a level state IN at the first decision close (2017-01-03) is a fresh signal; event and intraday detectors run every session, and triggers while long are ignored
conventions.minuteReference: E09/E10 references accumulate from the exit minute onwards, including the rest of the exit session (at the start from the minutes of 2017-01-03), and can trigger only from the next session; E10's reference starts at the exited trade's Hc
conventions.integerMapping: Sobol integer parameters: min(hi, floor(lo + u (hi - lo + 1)))
conventions.levelFresh: a level family's fresh signal is any flat close whose state is IN while no campaign is alive (the first decision close included); a state that lapsed and re-qualified during a trade therefore lets the next flat close enter after a stop (a first entry), while a state that stayed IN waits for the re-entry rule (disclosed asymmetry)

entries.definition: dd_s = 1 - C_s / max(C_{s-249..s}); OUT->IN when dd_s <= d_in; IN->OUT when dd_s >= d_out
A_N = (252/N) ln(C_s / C_{s-N}); OUT->IN when A_N >= a_in; IN->OUT when A_N < a_out

params.name: a_gap
params.note: a_out = a_in - a_gap; a_gap = 0 is the single-threshold rule

entries.definition: ER_N = (C_s - C_{s-N}) / sum_{i=s-N+1..s} |C_i - C_{i-1}|; OUT->IN when ER_N >= e_in and A_N >= 0.11; IN->OUT when ER_N <= e_out; ER = 0 when the path length is 0

z_s = r_s / (daily sd of r over s-60..s-1); U_s = max(0, U_{s-1} + z_s - kappa); D_s = max(0, D_{s-1} - z_s - kappa); OUT->IN when U_s >= h_in (then D := 0); IN->OUT when D_s >= h_out (then U := 0); U, D start at 0 when the first z is defined

causal zigzag on closes, reversal theta (mode undetermined until the first theta move from the running extreme); trigger at the close that confirms a swing low higher than the previous confirmed swing low; floor F = latest confirmed swing low
OUT->IN when sigma_20 <= v_in and C_s > C_{s-N}; IN->OUT when sigma_10 >= v_out or C_s < C_{s-N}

breakout at b: C_b > R = max(C_{b-N..b-1}); trigger at the close of b+A if C_i >= R for every i in b..b+A; a close below R first voids it; while a breakout is pending, a later breakout does not replace it; A = 0 is the raw breakout
box = sessions s-N..s-1; W = (max H - min L) / min L; trigger at the close of s when W <= c and C_s > max H of the box; the entry box's min L is recorded

while flat: low* = the lowest minute low since the exit minute (since the first minute of 2017-01-03 at the start), updated with each completed minute before the test; the decision is the first completed minute, in a session after the exit session, whose close >= low* (1 + Y)

entries.mechanism: M09-B upward breakout trailing buy (minute clock; variant of E09)
entries.definition: while flat: high* = max(the exited trade's Hc, the highest minute high since the exit minute) (at the start: the highest minute high since 2017-01-03's first minute), from earlier completed minutes; the decision is the first completed minute, in a session after the exit session, whose close > high* (1 + Yb)

permission ON at a close C_s >= max(C_{s-249..s}) (a new 250-session closing high, ties included); OFF at a close with 1 - C_s / (highest close since ON) >= D; while ON and flat: trigger at a close C_s > max(C_{s-n..s-1})

uptrend_s: C_s >= (1 + u) min(C_{s-125..s}) and the 250-session closing high max(C_{s-249..s}) was set at a session >= s-62 (the latest session attaining that maximum); pullback_s: some close in s-9..s is <= (1 - p) max(C over the 20 sessions ending at that close); trigger at the close of s with uptrend_s, pullback_s and C_s > H_{s-1}; the pullback low (lowest close of s-9..s) is recorded

exploratoryPrototype.mechanism: M15 closing strength (descriptive only: never searched or selected)
exploratoryPrototype.definition: CLV_s = (C_s - L_s)/(H_s - L_s), 0.5 if H = L; m_N = mean CLV over N; OUT->IN when m_N >= c_in and C_s > C_{s-N}; IN->OUT when m_N <= c_out

template.description: the single M3 search template: the family's own OUT (decided at the close, executed next open) + a resting hard stop h below the entry fill + a resting trailing stop t below the highest close since entry (updated at each close; first update at the entry session's close) + re-entry by R3 reclaim or a fresh signal, whichever comes first
template.stopLevel: the maximum of hard = raw first fill x (1 - h) and trailing = Hc x (1 - t), Hc = max(raw first fill, closes held); recomputed at each close, never lowered; both parts active from the fill bar

exits.OX: family own OUT + catastrophic resting stop 15% below the highest close since entry
exits.CX1: hard 8% below fill + trailing 10% below highest close (resting); own OUT disabled; re-entry R3 or fresh
exits.CX2: trend damage: C_s < min(C_{s-20..s-1}) (next open) + catastrophic resting stop 15% below the highest close; own OUT disabled
exits.X2: volatility-scaled trailing: level = Hc x (1 - clamp(k ATR_20 / Hc, 4%, 15%)), k = 3, ATR from the last completed session (at the fill: the previous close), never lowered; + hard 8%
exits.X3: structural rising floor (theta 5%, b 0.5%: close below floor -> next open) + emergency hard stop 10% below fill
exits.X4: two-layer: catastrophic resting stop 15% below the highest close + normal exit C_s < min(C_{s-50..s-1}) (next open)
exits.X5a: profit stages: hard 6%; after a close >= entry +4%: stop >= entry x 1.002; after a close >= entry +10%: trail 8% below the highest close; after a close >= entry +25%: trail 5%
exits.X5b: probation (M12): stop at raw first fill x (1 - 3%) until promotion at a close >= first fill x 1.05, then a 12% trailing stop below Hc (a deliberate widening, the one exception to never lowering a stop); not promoted at the close of its 10th session held -> exit next open
exits.X6a: X1 + maximum hold 60 sessions (exit at the open of the 61st session held)
exits.X6b: X1 + stall exit (M14): at a close with s - entry session >= 20, exit next open if C_s < C_{s-20} (1 + 20 x 0.11/252 + 0.01); the 0.11 is fixed (it does not follow a stressed interest rate)
exits.X8P: price damage only: trailing 10% below the highest close + hard 8%
exits.X8T: trend damage only: C_s < min(C_{s-20..s-1}) + catastrophic 15%
exits.X8OR: either price damage (trailing 10%) or trend damage (20-session low close) + hard 8%
exits.X8AND: exit next open only when both hold at a close: C_s <= highest close x 0.90 and C_s < min(C_{s-20..s-1}); + catastrophic 15%

reentry.R0: immediate: at the first later close while the campaign is alive (level: state IN; event: own OUT not yet true)
reentry.R2: fixed cool-down: no R-rule re-entry until 10 sessions after the exit (then R0); a fresh trigger enters earlier
reentry.R3: reclaim: a close above Hc of the stopped trade while the campaign is alive (a fresh trigger also enters)
reentry.R4: pullback recovery: a close >= trough + 0.5 (Hc - trough), trough = the lowest close from the exit session's close on, while the campaign is alive (a fresh trigger also enters)
reentry.R5: none while the campaign is alive (not even a fresh trigger); after its own OUT, a fresh signal
reentry.R3F: R3 or a fresh signal, whichever comes first (the template's rule and the default for every panel and M2 configuration except the R ablations)

sizing.Z1: progressive (M13): 1/3 of $100,000 at the entry fill; +1/3 at the opening trade after a close >= first raw fill x 1.03; +1/3 after a close >= x 1.06; each tranche its own lot (fill, friction, interest); one stop for the position, its hard part from the first tranche's raw fill
sizing.Z2: volatility target (M18) in $25,000 tranches: target count = clamp(floor(4 x 0.20 / sigma_20), 1, 4) from the decision close; entry at the target, re-sized at the next opening trade whenever the count changes; partial sales FIFO

modifiers.A1: exhaustion filter (M19): entry only if C_s / mean(C_{s-49..s}) - 1 <= 10%
modifiers.A2: weekly clock (M20): close decisions (entries and close-decided exits) only at Friday closes - no decision in a week whose Friday is a holiday; resting stops unchanged; not applied to the minute rules
modifiers.A3: single threshold (J ablation): exit threshold = entry threshold (E02: a_gap = 0; E01: d_gap = 0.001)

controls.C-SMA: IN when C_s > mean(C_{s-199..s}); OUT when C_s < it; next-open execution; no stops
controls.C-DON: enter at the open after C_s > max(C_{s-55..s-1}); exit at the open after C_s < min(C_{s-20..s-1}); no stops
controls.C-TSM: at the close of the first session of each month: IN if C_s > C_{s-250}, else OUT; executed at the next opening trade; no stops
controls.C-AL: one $100,000 lot bought at the opening trade of 2017-01-04 and held to the horizon (its exposure drifts with the price: not a fixed-slot comparator)
controls.C-ALR: $100,000 notional re-sized at the opening trade of the first session of each month (friction on the traded difference; interest on $100,000): the always-long fixed-slot reference
controls.D1: registered VGT primary (config/phenotypes/D1/VGT.json), frozen engine via Study 2's standaloneRun; context only
controls.C-SMA/TPL, C-DON/TPL, C-TSM/TPL: each conventional control signal with the TPL default exits (hard 8%, trailing 10%, own OUT, R3F)

duplicates: exits: X1 = CX1 = X6c = X8P; X8T = CX2. Entries: E01 at d_in = 0, E07 at A = 0, E11 and C-DON are all N-session-high rules; E02 at a_in = a_gap = 0 is close to C-TSM.
